hook.name: ReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A reflection-token hook that charges a 1.7% fee on buys (ETH collected into a pot for periodic automated buybacks) and 1.7% on sells (tokens sent to the token contract's reflection bucket). Only one liquidity addition per pool is ever allowed. Sells in the same block as a buyback revert, and a deployer-controlled allowlist in afterSwap can selectively block sells by address.
